# Merge clusters

```{r}
# Merge clusters
v6.1 <- RenameIdents(v6.1, c(`0` = "JCF", `1` = "SHF", `2` = "JCF", `3` = "SHF", `4` = "SHF", `5` = "JCF", `6` = "JCF", `7` = "CM", `8` = "CM"))
v6.1$clusterAnn <- Idents(v6.1)

# Version 2 of annotation separating clusters 7 and 8 into early CM and CM
v6.1[[]] <- v6.1[[]] %>%
  mutate(clusterAnn2 = recode(SCT_snn_res.0.5, !!!c(`0` = "JCF", `1` = "SHF", `2` = "JCF", `3` = "SHF", `4` = "SHF", `5` = "JCF", `6` = "JCF", `7` = "intermediate", `8` = "CM")))

cluster_colors <- c(`JCF` = "#A5D171", `SHF`= "#8FA2F2" ,`CM` = "#EF6507")

v6.1$clusterAnn <- factor(v6.1$clusterAnn, levels= c("JCF", "SHF", "CM"))
Idents(v6.1) <- v6.1$clusterAnn


cluster_colors <- c(`JCF` = "#A5D171", `SHF`= "#8FA2F2" ,`intermediate` = "#FF8C00" ,`CM` = "#FF4500") 
v6.1$clusterAnn2 <- factor(v6.1$clusterAnn2, levels= c("JCF", "SHF", "intermediate" ,"CM"))
Idents(v6.1) <- "clusterAnn2"

```

# Tyser clusters feature plots

```{r}
Tyser_markers <- list(Me4 = c("Sfrp5","Wnt2","Gata4","Gata5","Tbx5","Tenm4","Bmp2","Hcn4","Rem1","Dbt"),
                      Me7 = c("Bcat1","Crabp1","Nnat","Aplnr","Ifitm1","Meis1","Car14","Hapln1","Isl1","Igfbpl1"),
                   Me5= c("Phlda2","Pmp22","Nrp1","Hand1","Tmem88","Bmp4","Ccdc80","Tmem108","Msx2","Ugdh"),
                   Me3 = c("Actc1","Acta2","Myl7","Myl4","Tnnt2","Tnni1","Ttn","Tnnc1","Myh6","Myl3"))

# Extract the list of genes present in the Seurat object
seurat_genes <- rownames(v6.1)

# Function to filter the markers list
filter_markers <- function(markers_list, seurat_genes) {
  filtered_list <- lapply(markers_list, function(gene_set) {
    intersect(gene_set, seurat_genes)  # Keep only genes present in the Seurat object
  })
  return(filtered_list)
}
Tyser_markers <- filter_markers(Tyser_markers, seurat_genes)

v6.1 <- AddModuleScore_UCell(v6.1, Tyser_markers)
v6.1 <- SmoothKNN(v6.1, c("Me4_UCell", "Me7_UCell", "Me5_UCell", "Me3_UCell"), reduction="harmony")
```

```{r}
custom_breaks <- function(x) {
  seq(min(x), max(x), length.out = 2) # 2 breaks: min, max
}
```

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}

p1 = FeaturePlot(v6.1, features = "Me4_UCell_kNN", order = TRUE, coord.fixed = T, pt.size = 0.2, max.cutoff = 0.2) +
  scale_color_viridis(option='E', breaks = custom_breaks, labels= c("low", 'high')) +
  NoAxes() +
  ggtitle("Intermediate") &
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=12, hjust=0.5),rect = element_rect(fill = "transparent"))


p2 = FeaturePlot(v6.1, features = "Me3_UCell_kNN", order = TRUE, coord.fixed = T, pt.size = 0.2) +
  scale_color_viridis(option='E', breaks = custom_breaks, labels= c("low", 'high')) +
  NoAxes() +
  ggtitle("CM") &
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=12, hjust=0.5),rect = element_rect(fill = "transparent"))

p3 = FeaturePlot(v6.1, features = "Me5_UCell_kNN", order = TRUE, coord.fixed = T, pt.size = 0.2, max.cutoff = .4) +
  scale_color_viridis(option='E', breaks = custom_breaks, labels= c("low", 'high')) +
  NoAxes() +
  ggtitle("JCF") &
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=12, hjust=0.5),rect = element_rect(fill = "transparent"))

p4 = FeaturePlot(v6.1, features = "Me7_UCell_kNN", order = TRUE, coord.fixed = T, pt.size = 0.2, max.cutoff = 0.25) +
  scale_color_viridis(option='E', breaks = custom_breaks, labels= c("low", 'high')) +
  NoAxes() +
  ggtitle("SHF") &
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=12, hjust=0.5),rect = element_rect(fill = "transparent"))


p1+p2+p3+p4 + plot_layout(ncol=4) & theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill='transparent'))
ggsave('plots/Feature_Tyser_scores.svg', width = 12, height = 6, bg='transparent')
```

# Known markers

## WT only

```{r}
wt_subset <- subset(v6.1, Genotype == "Ctl")
markers <- list(JCF = c("Hand1", "Mab21l2", "Foxf1"), 
                SHF = c("Isl1", "Osr1", "Fgf8", "Fgf10", "Arg1"), 
                CM = c("Ttn", "Myh6", "Myl7", "Nkx2-5", "Gata4", "Tbx5"))
markers_vector <- unlist(markers)
names(markers_vector) <- NULL

magic_imputed_subset <- magic_imputed[colnames(wt_subset), markers_vector]
magic_imputed_subset <- scale(magic_imputed_subset, scale=T, center = T)
magic_imputed_subset <- t(magic_imputed_subset)
```

```{r, fig.height=3.2, fig.width=6}
cluster_colors <- c(`JCF` = "#A5D171", `SHF`= "#8FA2F2" ,`intermediate` = "#DAA03DFF" ,`CM` = "#EF6507")
color = colorRamp2(c(-1,0,1), hcl_palette = "cividis")

top_annotation <- HeatmapAnnotation(df = select(wt_subset[[]], clusterAnn2), col = list(clusterAnn2 = cluster_colors),show_annotation_name = F, show_legend = T, simple_anno_size = unit(0.3, "cm"), annotation_legend_param = list(title=""))

htmp <- Heatmap(magic_imputed_subset, col=color ,column_split = wt_subset$clusterAnn2, show_column_names = F, cluster_columns = F, heatmap_legend_param = list(title="Relative expression", legend_direction="horizontal", title_position = "topcenter"), top_annotation = top_annotation, column_title = NULL)

png("plots/Heatmap_SHF_JCF_CM_knownMarkers_WT_only.png", width = 6, height = 3.2, res = 1200, bg="transparent", units = "in")
draw(htmp, heatmap_legend_side="bottom")
dev.off()
```

# Hh score

## WT

```{r}
hh_activity <- list(Hh_activity = c("Gli1", "Hhip", "Ptch1"))

v6.1 <- AddModuleScore_UCell(v6.1, hh_activity)
v6.1 <- SmoothKNN(v6.1,
                           signature.names = "Hh_activity_UCell",
                           reduction="harmony")

v6.1 <- AddModuleScore(v6.1, hh_activity, name = "Hh_activity", assay = "RNA", slot = 'data')
```

## Global

### Stats

```{r}
global_comparison <- v6.1[[]] %>%
  wilcox_test(Hh_activity_UCell_kNN ~ Genotype) %>%
  add_xy_position() %>%
  add_x_position() %>%
  add_significance()
```

```{r}
stats_clusterwise <- v6.1[[]] %>%
  group_by(clusterAnn2) %>%
  wilcox_test(Hh_activity_UCell_kNN ~ Genotype) %>%
  adjust_pvalue(method='fdr') %>% 
  add_xy_position(x="Genotype") %>%
  add_significance()

write_csv(stats_clusterwise[c(1:9,14)], 'tables/Wilcox_clusterwise_Hh_activity_OEvsCtl.csv')
```

```{r, fig.width=9, fig.height=3}
cluster_colors <- c(`JCF` = "#A5D171", `SHF`= "#8FA2F2" ,`intermediate` = "#FF8C00" ,`CM` = "#FF4500")
# Convert colors to a list of element_rect objects with transparency
strip_backgrounds <- lapply(cluster_colors, function(color) element_rect(fill = scales::alpha(color, 0.9), color = NA))

plots <- ggplot(v6.1[[]], aes(x = Genotype, y = Hh_activity_UCell_kNN)) +
  geom_violin(aes(fill = Genotype, color= Genotype)) +
  #stat_pvalue_manual(stats_clusterwise, label = "FDR = {format(p.adj, scientific = TRUE, digits = 2)}") +
  stat_pvalue_manual(stats_clusterwise, label = "p.adj.signif", tip.length=0) +
   stat_summary(fun = median, fun.min = median, fun.max = median,
               geom = "crossbar", width = 0.2, color = "white", size = 0.2)+
  theme_light(base_size = 18) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Hh activity score") +
  theme(
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    legend.position = 'none',
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(margin = margin(t = 6, b = 0), size = 16),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size=14),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size=12), 
    panel.spacing = unit(2, "lines"),
    rect = element_rect(fill='transparent'), plot.background = element_rect(fill='transparent'), panel.background = element_rect(fill = 'transparent')
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("gray", "#906a44"))+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("gray", "#906a44"))+
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(add = c(0.01, 0.03)), breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(n = 2.5)) +
  facet_wrap2(
    ~ clusterAnn2, 
    ncol = 4, 
    #scales = "free_y", 
    strip = ggh4x::strip_themed(
      background_x = strip_backgrounds
    )
  )
plots
ggsave("plots/Vln_Hh_activity_Clusters.svg", width = 9, height = 3, bg="transparent")
```

```{r}
ctl <-v6.1[[]] %>%
  filter(Genotype == 'Ctl')
kruskal_test(Hh_activity_UCell_kNN ~ clusterAnn2, data=ctl)
```

```{r}
pairwise_wilcox <- ctl %>%
  pairwise_wilcox_test(Hh_activity_UCell_kNN~ clusterAnn2, p.adjust.method = 'BH', ref.group = 'CM') %>%
  add_xy_position(x="clusterAnn2") %>%
  add_significance()
pairwise_wilcox
write_csv(pairwise_wilcox[1:9], 'tables/Pairwise_Wilcox_Hh_activity_Ctl.csv')
```
